operations.description:
Returns payment, refund, and cash-drawer transactions filtered by **payment date** (`payment_date`), not invoice created date.

Use this endpoint to reproduce cash-basis Store Summary / Sales totals — revenue recognized on the day money was collected (tax included). `GET /invoices` filters by invoice **created date** (`order_date`) and cannot match cash-basis daily sales.

**Auth:** Same as the rest of the API — `api_key` query parameter, HTTP Basic, or Bearer token.

**Date filter (`from` / `to`):**
- Unix timestamps as query parameters, interpreted in **UTC**, applied to `payment_date` (and to shift start time / expense date for those row types).
- Example: `from=1786579200&to=1786665599` is 13 Aug 2026 00:00:00–23:59:59 UTC.
- Both `from` and `to` must be sent together.
- If either is omitted, the endpoint defaults to **today** (the authenticated store's current date).

**Cash-basis daily sales:**
Sum only rows where `type` is `Payment` or `Refund`. Amounts include tax and are net of change given. Refunds are negative. Alternatively, send `Type_id=1,2` and use `summary.combined_total` for the requested range.

Do **not** treat `Manual In`, `Manual Out`, `Shift`, `Trade In`, or `Expense` as sales — those are cash-drawer / non-sales movements. If you request all types, do **not** use `summary.combined_total` as Total Sales.

**Row types (`Type_id`):**
- **1 — Payment:** Sales (cash-basis revenue collected).
- **2 — Refund:** Sales (reduces cash-basis revenue; amount is negative).
- **3 — Trade In:** Non-sales / cash-drawer (device purchase payout).
- **4 — Manual In:** Cash-drawer movement.
- **5 — Manual Out:** Cash-drawer movement.
- **6 / 7 — Shift:** Shift start / end (opening and closing balance; not a sale).
- **8 — Expense:** Non-sales / cash-drawer.

Default `Type_id` is all types `1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8`.

**Response notes:**
- `date` is a Unix timestamp.
- `transaction_datetime` is the same instant in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` in the store timezone.
- `source` is a title string (not an integer), e.g. `Web App`, `Online`, `Open API`.
- `amount` values are formatted currency strings (e.g. `$230.00`, `-$25.00`), net of change given.

This endpoint is **not paginated**; all matching rows are returned in one response.

**Example request:**
`GET /v1/report/transactionlogs?api_key={api_key}&from=1786579200&to=1786665599&Type_id=1,2`

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the payment_date range as a Unix timestamp (UTC). Must be sent together with `to`. If omitted (or `to` is omitted), defaults to today.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the payment_date range as a Unix timestamp (UTC). Must be sent together with `from`. If omitted (or `from` is omitted), defaults to today.

parameters.name: Type_id
parameters.description: Transaction type filter. Comma-separated IDs or a single integer. 1=Payment, 2=Refund, 3=Trade In, 4=Manual In, 5=Manual Out, 6=Shift start, 7=Shift end, 8=Expense. Default: all types. Use `1,2` for cash-basis sales only. Parameter name is case-sensitive (`Type_id`).

operations.description:
Update ticket details.

**Devices in the payload**: Correspond to **Ticket Line Items**.

**Parts in the payload**: Represent the **parts attached to the ticket during its creation**.

**Image URLs**: Use **pre_image_urls** and **post_image_urls** arrays in each device to automatically fetch and upload images from public URLs.

**Request Body Parameters:**

**Ticket**:
   - **id**: Required. The unique identifier for the ticket. This **id** corresponds to the **id** inside the **summary** object in the payload.

**Ticket Line Item**:
   - **id**: Required. If the line item exists, provide its **id** (this **id** corresponds to the **id** inside the **devices** object in the payload). If the line item does not exist, a new one will be created.
   - **name**: Required. The name of the service to be updated. If **repairProdItems** are provided, the service name will be updated by concatenating all the provided names. If **repairProdItems** are not provided, the device name will remain unchanged in its original form unless updated by modifying the **name** field inside **devices** (e.g., { "name": "updated name" }).
   - **device**: Required. Inside the **devices** object, the **device** field (e.g., "device": 123) represents the **id** from the **app_devices** table.
   - **pre_image_urls**: Optional. Array of public image URLs (http/https) for pre-condition images. Max 15 MB per image.
   - **post_image_urls**: Optional. Array of public image URLs (http/https) for post-condition images. Max 15 MB per image.
   - **due_on**: Represents the due date of line item in Unix timestamp format.

**Parts**:
   - The **id** inside the **parts** object (e.g., "parts": 604) corresponds to the **app_ticket_inv_parts** table. If the **id** exists in the table, it means the part is already attached to the ticket and will be updated. If the **id** is not provided in the **parts** section of the payload, a new entry will be created in the **app_ticket_inv_parts** table, and the part will be associated with the ticket.
   - To update ticket parts, use the crossId value (retrieved from  **tickets/{Ticket-Id} Get Single Ticket**) in the Parts array of Update Ticket to specify the part id.

pre_image_urls.description: Public URLs of pre-condition images (http/https). Images will be fetched and uploaded automatically. Max 15 MB per image. Supported formats: JPEG, PNG, GIF.

post_image_urls.description: Public URLs of post-condition images (http/https). Images will be fetched and uploaded automatically. Max 15 MB per image. Supported formats: JPEG, PNG, GIF.

operations.summary: Update ticket line item status or repair timer
operations.description:
Update the status of a ticket line item and/or control the repair timer (start, stop, or add custom time) for a specific repair/service on a ticket.

At least one of **status** or **timerAction** must be provided. Both may be sent in the same request.

**Request Body Parameters:**

- **id** (required): The unique identifier for the ticket. This corresponds to the **id** field inside the **summary** object returned by the **GET /tickets/{Ticket Id}** endpoint (i.e., `data.summary.id`).
- **ticketInvId** (required): The unique identifier for the ticket line item (service) to be updated. This corresponds to the **id** field inside the **devices** array returned by the **GET /tickets/{Ticket Id}** endpoint (i.e., `data.devices[].id`).
- **status** (optional): The new status to assign to the line item (e.g., "In Progress", "Completed", "Pending"). Required if **timerAction** is not provided.
- **timerAction** (optional): Repair timer action. Allowed values: `start`, `stop`, `custom`. Required if **status** is not provided.
  - `start` — starts the repair timer on the line item (sets `start_time` and `timer = 1` on `app_ticket_inv`).
  - `stop` — stops the running repair timer, creates a time log entry in `app_ticket_inv_time_log`, and updates `timer_duration`.
  - `custom` — adds a manual/custom time entry without starting a live timer. Requires at least one of **days**, **hours**, **minutes**, or **seconds** to be greater than 0.
- **days** (optional): Days of custom time. Used only when **timerAction** is `custom`. Default: 0.
- **hours** (optional): Hours of custom time. Used only when **timerAction** is `custom`. Default: 0.
- **minutes** (optional): Minutes of custom time. Used only when **timerAction** is `custom`. Default: 0.
- **seconds** (optional): Seconds of custom time. Used only when **timerAction** is `custom`. Default: 0.

**Sample Payloads:**

Update status only:
```json
{
  "id": 3266,
  "ticketInvId": 10231,
  "status": "In Progress"
}
```

Start repair timer:
```json
{
  "id": 3266,
  "ticketInvId": 10231,
  "timerAction": "start"
}
```

Stop repair timer:
```json
{
  "id": 3266,
  "ticketInvId": 10231,
  "timerAction": "stop"
}
```

Add custom/manual repair time:
```json
{
  "id": 3266,
  "ticketInvId": 10231,
  "timerAction": "custom",
  "hours": 1,
  "minutes": 30
}
```

Update status and start timer together:
```json
{
  "id": 3266,
  "ticketInvId": 10231,
  "status": "In Progress",
  "timerAction": "start"
}
```

id.description: Ticket summary ID (data.summary.id from GET /tickets/{Ticket Id})

ticketInvId.description: Ticket line item / repair ID (data.devices[].id from GET /tickets/{Ticket Id})

status.description: New status for the line item. Required if timerAction is not provided.

timerAction.description: Repair timer action: start, stop, or custom. Required if status is not provided.

days.description: Days of custom time. Used when timerAction is custom.

hours.description: Hours of custom time. Used when timerAction is custom.

minutes.description: Minutes of custom time. Used when timerAction is custom.

seconds.description: Seconds of custom time. Used when timerAction is custom.

operations.description:
Upload one or more files into a ticket's **Attachments** section. Intended for third-party / unattended integrations that cannot use the session-based attachment upload used by the app UI.

Uploaded files are stored securely and are not publicly accessible by direct link; staff view/download them from within the app. Attachments uploaded through this endpoint are always **internal** and are never shown on the customer portal.

**Authentication:** Bearer token, OAuth, API key, or Basic auth.

**OAuth module:** `tickets`  
**OAuth capability:** `update`  
OAuth tokens without ticket update permission receive a `403` response.

**Request Body Parameters (multipart/form-data):**
- **ticket_id**: Required*. The ticket ID. Also accepts `id` as an alias.
- **file**: Required**. A single uploaded file.
- **files[]**: Required**. One or more uploaded files. Also accepts `files`.
- **notes**: Optional. Note text stored on each attachment.
- **ticket_inv_id**: Optional. Ticket device/line item ID; must belong to the same ticket.

\* Provide either `ticket_id` or `id`.  
\*\* Provide at least one file via `file` and/or `files` / `files[]`.

`ticket_id` and `ticket_inv_id` are scoped to the authenticated tenant and current store.

**Limits:**
- Max file size: 15 MB per file
- Max files per request: 10
- Allowed extensions: gif, jpeg, jpg, png, xls, xlsx, xltx, doc, docx, pdf, pptx, ppt, txt, heic, heif
- Not allowed: html, htm (excluded for XSS risk)
- `heic` / `heif` are accepted as opaque uploads (no format conversion)

ticket_id.description: The ticket ID. Also accepts 'id' as alias.

file.description: Single uploaded file. Also accepts 'files' / 'files[]' for multiple files.

files.description: One or more uploaded files (files[]). Alternative to 'file'.

notes.description: Optional note stored on each attachment row.

ticket_inv_id.description: Optional ticket device / line item ID; must belong to the same ticket.
